plugins.name: ciwg-knowledge
plugins.description: Company knowledge auto-injection: relevant call transcripts, chat logs and Fathom meetings (tickets/team-chat/notes as their ingestion ships) flow into Claude's context automatically — retrieval happens in hooks, outside the model, with zero tool-call overhead. Sign in once with CIWG SSO (/ciwg-login) — no API tokens. Includes explicit MCP search tools on the same sign-in.
